real_market_data.reason: Binance api.binance.com canary returned HTTP 451; official market-data-only endpoint has not yet been canaried.
real_market_data.requirement: At least 26280 validated closed hourly candles per required asset, genuine provenance, content hashes, persisted artifacts, independent readback.

lane_policy.priority_rule: Select the READY lane with the lowest numeric priority whose dependencies are satisfied. If one lane is blocked externally, work the next independent READY lane.
lane_policy.isolation_rule: Keep strategy code, protocol, tests, reports, and state lane-local. Changes to shared campaign/data/checkpoint files must be reviewed separately and must not be mixed with hypothesis experiments.
lane_policy.synthetic_fixture_rule: Synthetic candles may be used only for deterministic software fixtures and must never be presented as market history or economic evidence.
lane_policy.concurrency_note: The repository currently has one workflow concurrency group and one shared main branch. This queue removes research-task coupling but does not create simultaneous jobs in this repository. For actual compute parallelism, run lanes in separate repositories or separately authorized workflows; do not add another workflow to this repository as a workaround.

lanes.scope: Research the official market-data-only Binance endpoint and validate explicit same-provider failover; keep a strict fail-closed policy.
completion_criteria: Canary is run from the intended GitHub Actions runner.
HTTP status and response source are recorded.
If both official endpoints fail, report BLOCKED_EXTERNAL without synthetic fallback.

lanes.scope: Identify one materially distinct breakout hypothesis by inspecting existing specifications/results first; write a preregistered, testable protocol and deterministic known-answer fixtures.
completion_criteria: Hypothesis is falsifiable and materially different from existing tested configurations.
Signal time, execution time, stops, costs, fold boundaries and invalid-data behavior are specified.
No historical profitability claim is made before the real-data gate passes.
A later confirmatory evaluation window is preregistered if any candidate selection exposed historical holdout data.

lanes.scope: Implement BRAIN-004 and BRAIN-005 as one isolated reliability task without requiring market data.
required_artifacts: bounded immutable JSONL shard writer (each shard <= 4 MiB)
legacy migration verification or explicit legacy-unverified status
completion_criteria: Resume cursor is derived from verified result records, not counters.
Crash injection proves no silent skips or duplicate committed experiments.
Legacy monolithic result is preserved until integrity is verified.
No force-push is used to erase historical blobs.

lanes.scope: Implement BRAIN-003 phase separation while real-data acquisition proceeds independently.
completion_criteria: Development and validation code cannot access final holdout rows.
Holdout evaluation consumes only a frozen candidate and frozen protocol.
Historical exposure remains EXPOSED_OR_UNKNOWN unless independently established.

lanes.scope: Implement BRAIN-002 evidence-only pilot plus independent campaign authorization.
required_artifacts: negative tests for forged authorization booleans
completion_criteria: campaign_authorized=true is never accepted without independent validation of persisted evidence.
Campaign startup revalidates evidence hashes and required gates.
